description: Defines the egl::Surface class and related classes for managing drawing surfaces in EGL, including window, pbuffer, and pixmap surfaces, with associated state and implementation details.

classes.name: Surface
classes.description: Represents an EGL drawing surface, manages its state, implementation, and interactions with the rendering context.

classes.name: SurfaceState
classes.description: Holds configuration and attribute state for a surface, including labels, timestamps, and direct composition flag.

classes.name: PbufferSurface
classes.description: Specialized Surface for pixel buffer rendering.

classes.name: PixmapSurface
classes.description: Specialized Surface for native pixmap rendering.

classes.name: SurfaceDeleter
classes.description: Manages deletion of Surface objects, ensuring proper cleanup.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets a label for the surface.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label of the surface.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the surface with the display.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes the surface current in the given context.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the buffers of the surface.

methods.name: swapWithDamage
methods.description: Swaps buffers with damage regions specified.

methods.name: swapWithFrameToken
methods.description: Swaps buffers using a frame token.

methods.name: postSubBuffer
methods.description: Posts a sub-region of the surface.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds a texture image to the surface.

methods.name: isPostSubBufferSupported
methods.description: Checks if post sub-buffer is supported.

methods.name: setFixedWidth
methods.description: Sets fixed width for the surface.

methods.name: setFixedHeight
methods.description: Sets fixed height for the surface.

methods.name: createDefaultFramebuffer
methods.description: Creates a default framebuffer for the surface.

methods.name: getLargestPbuffer
methods.description: Indicates if the surface is a large pbuffer.

methods.name: getMipmapTexture
methods.description: Indicates if mipmap texture is used.

methods.name: getBoundTexture
methods.description: Returns the texture bound to the surface.

methods.name: isFixedSize
methods.description: Checks if the surface has fixed size.

methods.name: getAttachmentSize
methods.description: Gets attachment size for an image.

methods.name: getAttachmentFormat
methods.description: Gets attachment format for an image.

methods.name: getAttachmentSamples
methods.description: Gets attachment samples for an image.

methods.name: isRenderable
methods.description: Checks if the surface is renderable.

methods.name: directComposition
methods.description: Checks if direct composition is enabled.
